name: R2 Low Density Residential
source: SMMC 9.08.030 Table; 9.21 (daylight plane, R1 boundary setbacks); City Housing Element 2021-2029 Appendix E Figure E-2
verified: 2026-09-23 setbacks, height and coverage from the City Housing Element table; daylight plane and R1-boundary setbacks from code excerpts; confirm the side stepback wording ('2 ft average at each story') in the current code
notes: Front setback: 20 ft (or per Official Districting Map).
Side setbacks: parcels 50 ft or wider: 8 ft; narrower parcels: 16% of parcel width, min 4 ft.
Height: 2 stories / 30 ft (100% affordable projects: no story limit / 30 ft).
Parcel coverage: ground floor 45%; upper stories 90% of the allowable ground-floor coverage (upper-story figure not modeled).
Daylight plane: above 23 ft nothing may cross a plane starting 23 ft above the front setback line and rising at 45 degrees toward the rear.
Upper-story side stepback: an additional 2 ft average side stepback at each story above the ground floor. Modeled as a flat 2 ft on stories 2+ (approximation of an average).
Edges abutting an R1 district: 10 ft interior side setback, 20 ft rear setback. Flag those edges as 'adjacent low density'.
Density: 1 unit per 2,000 sf of parcel (or 4 units, whichever is less) not modeled.
